node.title: Re: Detecting 'our $foo => 1' mistake? (updated)
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Hi [perlancar],

Could you provide an [id://1177642|SSCCE] that demonstrates the problem? As the AM already pointed out, the code you showed does provide a warning:

$ perl -wMstrict -e 'our $foo => { a=>"blah", b=>"blah" };' Useless use of anonymous hash ({}) in void context at -e line 1.

Update: Ok, the code you showed in the title does not warn. Standard [doc://Perl::Critic] doesn't seem to catch this one either, and I don't yet see any add-on policies that catch this. Update 2: See my [id://1180082|other reply].

$ perl -wMstrict -e 'our $foo => 1;' $

Regards,
-- Hauke D
